This is a genuine UNIFORM-VOLUME extension beyond the accepted fixed-class positive-gap compiler, not a full arbitrary-rank theorem. ROOT constructed the following complete argument/explicit constants; standard product-law, one-dimensional log-concavity, Bezout and path-comparison machinery credited once. PROOF/COMPILER. Rank0 classes are singleton. For rank1 compute an integral primitive vectorv and integersh_r withz_r-y_r=h_r v. Positive conservationw.v=0 forcesv to have both signs. The whole nonnegative integer line throughx0 can be parameterised x(k)=a+k v,0<=k<=N, by exact integer ceiling/floor endpoints. Let A=max(1,ceil(R/min_i w_i)); all coordinates on the line are<=AV and N<=AV. Actual Gamma may occupy only part of this line; do not replace it by a residue class at the boundary.

Use Q_sym=(Q+Q*)/2 only in the ANALYSIS; it has EXACTLY the original Dirichlet form. Stationary adjoint ofy->z isz->y with coefficientkappa*c^(y-z) and volume factorV^(1-|z|). Weak reversibility realises the reversed population edge by an actual finite complex-cycle word, so symmetrization stays in the same actual class. Let Y=max_(r,i){y_ri,z_ri}, M=max(1,max_r{|y_r|,|z_r|}), and beta=1/2*min_r{kappa_r,kappa_r*c^(y_r-z_r)} over nonzero jumps. Every enabled symmetrized reaction channel has rate>=beta*V^(1-M).

Coordinates withv_i=0 are frozen. Delete channels whose frozen source coordinates exceedx0_i; source and target frozen coordinates agree, so a channel and its adjoint are deleted together. LetF be the retained original channels. IfF empty the class is singleton. For EACH possible nonemptyF (finitely many, at most2^reactioncount), use extended Euclid to form a finite signed word in its jumps with netg_F=gcd_(r in F)|h_r|>0. Negative signs mean the adjoint channel. Let W_F=max absolute partial sum of this word (including0 and its endpoint), and J_F=max_(r in F)|h_r|. All these are fixed computable integers independent ofV/x0. Put K_F=Y+W_F+J_F+1.
